bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 51
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test -n "$CID" || exit 52
NEXT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-app-reuse-9738e45 --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$NEXT" || exit 53
docker logs --since=5m "$CID" 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY || exit 54
cd "$P"
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/tmp/gace-room-app-userbot-health.txt || exit 55
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py room_private_smoke >/tmp/gace-room-app-userbot-room-smoke.txt || exit 56
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 57
echo ROOM_APP_REUSE_RUNTIME_AND_RESIDENT_USERBOT_SAFE_SMOKE_PASS
echo SOURCE_SHA=9738e451d8fd9485954bf3737e68a90798e1650b
